Some [[Time/Legends|time]] before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]],<ref name="CSWE-Mist">{{CSWECite|II|319|Mist}}</ref> [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] authorized an '''attack'''<ref name="e">''[[Endgame]]''</ref> on the [[Shella Inion's hometown|hometown]]<ref name="CSWE-Inion">{{CSWECite|II|103|Inion, Shella}}</ref> of [[Mist (bounty hunter)|Shella Inion]]. He blamed the attack on the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="e" />
